flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/{plusintegration/controllers/PlusIntegrationController (plus-furnish-redirect-check), helpers/FurnishabilityChecker.checkFurnishability, stafffurnish/services/StaffFurnishService.staffFurnish, manual/helpers/ManualFurnishValidationService.checkExistingParticulars, dto/ExistingParticularsResponse}, workflows/notice_management/ownerdriver/ownerdriver/OwnerDriverControllerPlus (plus-offence-notice-owner-driver). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code for the overwrite-check from PLUS
note: Story status: Requirement given - Gen flow. Demo remark: 'PLUS Original - Check API-DB. BE may need rebuild. Latest PLUS DB deployment 20 sept - API not pulling in. Suspect connection to DB drop' (a claim from the sheet, not judged from code). On the PLUS path only the furnishable check exists (PS, Advisory Notice, stage). The check 'existing particulars will be overwritten' exists on the staff manual furnish path (checkExistingParticulars) but is not called by any plus-* endpoint, and ocmsadminui does not call it. When PLUS calls /plus-furnish, the old offender is set to indicator N and all address records for that role are deleted (OCMS-DF-2026-024, Closed, Prod deployed), and the owner_driver record with the same key (notice_no, owner_driver_indicator) is overwritten because the primary key is the same. So the condition 'without deleting past records' is not met. Alert to PLUS: cannot verify from repo, no outbound code to PLUS exists.
recommendation: Claim only part of it (the furnishable check from PLUS works). The 'particulars will be overwritten' check does not exist on the PLUS path, and deleting old addresses contradicts 'without deleting past records'. Needed: an existing-particulars check in plus-furnish-redirect-check and a decision on keeping history records.

steps.step: PLUS asks OCMS whether the notice can be furnished or redirected (POST /plus-furnish-redirect-check)
steps.detail: plusFurnishRedirectCheck requires noticeNo (lines 71-75) and calls staffFurnishService.checkFurnishable (line 78), which delegates to FurnishabilityChecker.checkFurnishability: the notice must exist, have no active PS (line 107), not be an Advisory Notice (line 113), and its last processing stage must be in the furnishable list NPA to CPC (line 120). The result is returned as 'Notice is furnishable' or a rejection reason (lines 80-84). Matches the story precondition 'already checked the notice is furnishable'.

steps.step: OCMS checks whether existing hirer/driver particulars for the notice would be overwritten
steps.detail: The logic exists in ManualFurnishValidationService.checkExistingParticulars (lines 74-125): it reads all ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver records of the notice and returns hasExistingParticulars plus the hirer/driver list (ExistingParticularsResponse.java:18-47). But its endpoint GET /furnish/officer/manual/notice/{noticeNo}/check-existing (ManualFurnishController.java:72) belongs to the staff manual furnish path, not plus-*; ocmsadminui does not call it (grep 'check-existing' in ocmsadminui/src is empty). The endpoint plus-furnish-redirect-check (PlusIntegrationController.java:65-92) only checks PS/AN/stage and never reads the owner_driver table. PLUS can only pull old data itself via POST /plus-offence-notice-owner-driver (OwnerDriverControllerPlus.java:27-31); OCMS does not judge 'will be overwritten'. Sebagian: the logic exists but is not wired to the PLUS path.

steps.step: Old hirer/driver records are not deleted when replaced
steps.detail: StaffFurnishService.staffFurnish (used by /plus-furnish) sets the old offender to indicator N (line 201) and then DELETES all address records for that notice + role (deleteAllByNoticeNoAndOwnerDriverIndicator, lines 206-211; fix OCMS-DF-2026-024, Closed, Prod deployed, so the old address does not carry over to the new person). The new owner_driver record uses the same key (noticeNo, ownerDriverIndicator) as the old one (OcmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverId.java:19-20), so offenderService.save (line 231) overwrites the existing H/D row; no owner_driver history table was found in ocmsadminapi (grep owner_driver_hist/OwnerDriverHist is empty). Only the offender of the other role stays as indicator N. This contradicts 'without deleting past records'.

steps.step: The check result (particulars would be overwritten) is returned to PLUS as the basis for the alert
steps.detail: The plus-furnish-redirect-check response carries only furnishable true/false, reasonCode and reasonMessage (PlusIntegrationController.java:80-84; FurnishResponse.checkSuccess/checkFailure lines 294-310). There is no 'existing particulars' or 'willOverwrite' field or list of old particulars, and no outbound call to PLUS exists in any repo (properties only hold ocms.plus.key.validation, application-prod.properties:60-61). How PLUS shows the alert: cannot verify from repo.
